rules.name: verify-xoga747-missing-maturities-skip-uat
rules.sql: SELECT c.template_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.rule_data #> '{workflowConfig,additionalOutputs}') o WHERE o->>'source' = 'intermediateSheets.MissingOptionMaturities' AND o->>'skipWhenFlag' = 'noMissingOptionCandidates' AND o #>> '{options,headerWhenEmpty}' = 'true') AS outputs_with_flag, jsonb_array_length(c.rule_data #> '{workflowConfig,additionalOutputs}') AS additional_outputs FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules c WHERE c.code = 'PIPELINE CONFIG' AND c.template_name IN ('Financial - Options','Normal - Options') AND c.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' ORDER BY c.template_name

expect.reason: the missing maturities output has the flag and a header when empty
